svg.aria-label: A ShipNoble warehouse cut open: a pallet is scanned in and put away in rack slot A-03, a turret truck picks cartons from C-06 and a chilled carton from the cold room, they are kitted into one branded box at PK-01, and the box rolls into a ShipNoble truck at Dock 1, which pulls away.
